name: Embraer EMB-120 Brasilia
summary: Brazilian 30-seat pressurized regional turboprop with a low wing and a T-tail, popular with US commuter airlines in the 1990s.

wings: Low, straight wing with a slight taper
engines: Two Pratt & Whitney Canada PW118 turboprops in nacelles slung from the low wing
fuselage: Slender, round fuselage with a long, pointed nose and small oval windows
Airstair door at the rear left
tail: T-tail with a tall swept fin
Dorsal fillet at the fin root

tellTales: Low-wing regional turboprop with a T-tail
Slender fuselage with a long, pointed nose
Small oval windows and nacelles reaching behind the trailing edge

confusedWith.howToTell: The Saab 340 has a conventional low tail and a shorter, rounder fuselage; the EMB-120 has a T-tail and a slimmer fuselage.
The ATR has a high wing with a T-tail; the EMB-120 has a low wing.
The Dash 8 has a high wing and long nacelles holding the main gear; the EMB-120 has a low wing.
